title: Rebrand GrowteX Ventures: Logo, Color Palette, Tagline, Services, and Contact Details

requirements.summary: Design and integrate custom GrowteX Ventures wordmark logo with green accent and growth motif across Header, Hero, and Footer components
acceptanceCriteria: A wordmark logo image is generated and saved to frontend/public/assets/generated/
The logo appears in the Header, Hero section, and Footer
The logo uses a green-forward color consistent with the site's updated palette

file_operations.description: Replace the current logo/branding in the header with the new GrowteX Ventures wordmark logo using the generated image at frontend/public/assets/generated/growtex-logo.dim_400x100.png. Update the logo image source and ensure it links to the top of the page on click. Verify the component's current logo implementation before modifying.

Integrate the GrowteX Ventures wordmark logo into the hero section, displaying it prominently above or alongside the headline. Use the generated logo at frontend/public/assets/generated/growtex-logo.dim_400x100.png. Ensure proper sizing and alignment within the hero layout.

Replace the existing footer logo with the new GrowteX Ventures wordmark using the generated image at frontend/public/assets/generated/growtex-logo.dim_400x100.png. Position it at the top of the footer alongside the tagline as currently structured.

requirements.summary: Update site color palette from dark navy/charcoal to green-forward, clean neutral palette matching startupflora.com across all components and global styles
acceptanceCriteria: CSS custom properties in index.css are updated to a green-forward, clean neutral palette
Tailwind config color tokens reflect the new palette
All sections (Header, Hero, Services, About, Testimonials, Process, Contact, Footer) visually use the updated colors
No dark navy or charcoal backgrounds remain unless used as an intentional contrast accent

file_operations.description: Replace the current OKLCH-based CSS custom properties (background, foreground, primary, accent, etc.) with a green-forward, clean neutral palette inspired by startupflora.com. Use bright greens as primary colors, whites and light grays as backgrounds, and clean accent tones. Remove dark navy/charcoal tokens and update all theme variables to reflect the new palette. Ensure proper contrast ratios for accessibility.

Update the Tailwind theme color tokens to match the new green-forward palette. Replace navy and teal references with bright greens, neutral grays, and white-based tokens. Update primary, secondary, accent, and semantic color definitions to align with the updated CSS variables in index.css. Ensure color consistency across the configuration.

Update header background colors, text colors, and hover states to use the new green-forward palette. Replace any dark navy or charcoal styling with clean whites/light grays and green accents. Verify current styling before applying changes.

Update hero section background (replace or overlay the current background image with frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-bg-green.dim_1920x1080.png), text colors, CTA button colors, and stat row colors to reflect the new green-forward palette. Ensure high contrast between text and background for readability.

Update service card backgrounds, borders, icon colors, text colors, and hover effects to use the new green-forward palette with clean neutral tones. Replace any dark backgrounds with light grays or whites and use green accents for highlights.

Update the About section background, text colors, stat card colors, checklist styling, and replace the illustration with frontend/public/assets/generated/about-illustration-green.dim_800x600.png. Apply the new green-forward palette throughout, ensuring the section feels bright and clean.

Update testimonial card backgrounds, text colors, avatar styling, and quote colors to align with the new green-forward palette. Use light backgrounds with green accents for cards and ensure text remains readable.

Update process step card backgrounds, numbered badges, icon colors, borders, and hover effects to reflect the new green-forward, clean neutral palette. Replace dark elements with light grays/whites and green highlights.

Update contact form styling, input field backgrounds/borders, button colors, info panel background, and text colors to use the new green-forward palette. Ensure form elements have clean, accessible styling with green accents for interactive elements.

Update footer background color, text colors, link hover states, social icon styling, and divider colors to align with the new green-forward palette. Use a light or neutral footer background with green accents for links and icons.

requirements.summary: Update site tagline to 'From Vision to Victory' across Hero, Footer, HTML title, and meta description
acceptanceCriteria: Hero section displays 'From Vision to Victory' as the tagline
Footer displays 'From Vision to Victory' beneath the wordmark
HTML <title> and meta description in index.html reference GrowteX Ventures and 'From Vision to Victory'
No old tagline text remains on the page

file_operations.description: Replace the current hero tagline/subheadline text with 'From Vision to Victory'. Position it prominently below the main headline or integrate it into the hero messaging. Verify the current tagline location before updating.
Update the footer tagline text to display 'From Vision to Victory' beneath or alongside the GrowteX Ventures wordmark logo. Replace any existing tagline text with the new one.

Update the HTML <title> tag to include 'GrowteX Ventures - From Vision to Victory' or similar. Update the meta description to reference GrowteX Ventures and the tagline 'From Vision to Victory', providing a concise description of the company's mission and services.

requirements.summary: Replace all service cards with 8 new services (DPIIT Registration, MSME Registration, Trademark, Digital Marketing, Website Development, SEO, Performance Advertising) in responsive 3-column grid
acceptanceCriteria: Exactly 8 service cards are displayed in ServicesSection
Each card has a relevant icon, the correct service title, and a short description
Grid is 3 columns on desktop, 2 on tablet, 1 on mobile
Cards use the updated green-forward color palette with hover effects

file_operations.description: Replace all existing service cards with exactly 8 new service cards: (1) Startup India DPIIT Registration & Certification Application Assistance, (2) MSME Udyam Aadhaar Registration & Certification, (3) Trademark Registration & Application Services, (4) Digital Marketing — Social Media Management for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn & YouTube, (5) Website Development — WordPress, Shopify & Custom Code, (6) SEO — On-Page & Off-Page Services, (7) Performance & Advertising Services — Meta Ads, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads & YouTube Ads. Add an 8th service based on the pattern (consider bundling or adding a complementary service). Each card should have a relevant icon (select appropriate icons from Lucide or the existing icon library), a title matching the service name, and a concise 1-2 sentence description. Configure the grid to display 3 columns on desktop, 2 on tablet, and 1 on mobile using responsive Tailwind classes. Apply the new green-forward color palette with hover effects.

requirements.summary: Add phone number 7999866007 and email info@growteX.com as clickable links in Contact section info panel and Footer contact column
acceptanceCriteria: Phone 7999866007 appears in ContactSection info panel as a tel: link
Email info@growteX.com appears in ContactSection info panel as a mailto: link
Phone and email appear in the Footer's Contact column
Both are styled consistently with the surrounding text and the updated palette

file_operations.description: Add phone number 7999866007 as a clickable tel: link and email info@growteX.com as a clickable mailto: link to the contact info panel. Display them alongside any existing location or social links, using appropriate icons (phone and mail icons). Style consistently with the new green-forward palette and ensure proper spacing and alignment.

Add phone number 7999866007 (as a tel: link) and email info@growteX.com (as a mailto: link) to the Contact column in the footer. Position them logically within the existing footer structure, using consistent styling with the new palette and ensuring they are easily readable and clickable.
